quotes.verbatim_quote:
guitarists who play finger-style have a huge advantage over those who play only with a pick.

In exploring options like counterpoint, 3-part chords and unusual spread voicings,
finger-style guitarists can do much more of this material.
quotes.why_load_bearing: Establishes principle about technique choice shaping voicing access.

quotes.verbatim_quote:
Octave insertion is just what you might guess: inserting an octave between any 2 voices
within a 3-part chord or a 4-part chord.

Guitarists will see that they have already been playing these voicings,
but only as part of 4-part chords...
quotes.why_load_bearing: Connects new concept to existing knowledge.

quotes.verbatim_quote: Of course, all of this applies to the 3-part 4th voicings as well...
quotes.why_load_bearing: Extends octave insertion rule beyond triads.
